prompt:
PLAN 08B | THE CAMERA CANNOT BEAR TO WATCH
DURATION 15 SECONDS | HORIZONTAL 16:9

CHARACTER REFERENCES
{{CHAR_ARMAYIL_COOK}} 
{{CHAR_OLDER_BROTHER}}

LOCATION REFERENCES
{{LOC_PREP_ROOM}}

PROP REFERENCES
{{PROP_PREP_CLEAVER}}
{{PROP_WORK_STOOL}}

Create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 live-action cinematic sequence composed of three shots.

The entire sequence takes place inside one enclosed preparation room, with exactly two adult characters: Armayil and the Older Brother.

Preserve their referenced identities, body proportions, clothing and handmade masks. Armayil wears his established soiled cooking apron. Each mask remains physically fixed to its wearer’s head; its surface, features and eye openings retain their exact shape.

Use the same single cleaver throughout. Armayil holds it in his RIGHT hand. His LEFT hand is empty and available to touch the seated man.

The emotional center is Armayil’s inability to make himself perform the act. The camera operator appears physically affected by witnessing it: approaching reluctantly, withdrawing involuntarily, losing framing and recovering focus too late.

LOCATION AND LIGHT

An enclosed room with old Iranian masonry, rounded openings, a closed main door on the north wall, a metal work counter along the east wall and a closed narrow service exit on the west wall.

The floor is continuous and level.

A plain low wooden work stool stands near the center.

One hard neutral ceiling practical illuminates the stool, the seated man’s shoulders and Armayil’s hands. Faint warmer spill from a west-wall practical touches the edges of their clothing. The room’s corners remain deeply shadowed.

Keep this illumination stable throughout all three shots. Exposure remains restrained, with readable textures in the lit masks, hands, apron and blade.

START STATE AND BLOCKING

The Older Brother sits on the low stool facing SOUTH, toward the camera side of the room. Both feet remain on the floor. His hands rest tightly against his knees.

Armayil stands immediately behind him, slightly to the EAST of the stool. He faces SOUTH toward the seated man’s back.

For cameras positioned in the southern half of the room, the Older Brother occupies foreground LEFT or CENTER-LEFT, while Armayil occupies rear RIGHT.

Keep this relationship throughout. The camera moves only within the southern half-space and never circles behind both men.

Armayil already holds the single cleaver low beside his right thigh, its blade pointing toward the floor. His left hand hangs open beside him.

SHOT 08B-01 | 00s to 05s | 5 seconds
THE SEATED MAN LOWERS HIS HEAD

40mm intimate handheld from SOUTHWEST, at the Older Brother’s seated eye height.

Older occupies foreground left in a near-frontal three-quarter view. Armayil stands behind/right, his chest turned toward Older’s back.

Begin close enough to feel Older’s uneven breathing. His fingers press into his knees. He tries to steady himself, then slowly bows his masked head.

His shoulders remain tense; lowering his head costs him visible effort.

The camera takes a hesitant half-step closer, then drifts slightly right as though searching for Armayil’s response behind him.

Focus initially holds the seated mask. As the head lowers, focus slips briefly onto the fabric of Older’s shoulder, then recovers on Armayil’s trembling empty left hand beyond it.

Armayil starts to reach forward, stops halfway and draws a broken breath.

Cut during the hesitation, while his hand remains suspended.

SHOT 08B-02 | 05s to 09s | 4 seconds
THE HAND THAT CANNOT SETTLE

65mm close detail from SOUTH-CENTER, physically closer to the stool and slightly below standing chest height.

Older’s bowed head occupies lower left foreground. Armayil’s torso occupies right background. His LEFT hand reaches diagonally from upper right toward the crown and back of Older’s mask.

The fingers tremble several centimeters above the surface.

Armayil withdraws the hand a little, then forces himself to complete the gesture. His palm finally rests gently against the crown and back of the rigid mask.

Older’s head remains bowed. His shoulders rise with a frightened breath.

The camera follows the reaching fingers, but recoils slightly at contact. This involuntary movement briefly pushes the hand toward the edge of frame.

Focus overshoots onto the dark apron behind it, leaving the touching hand soft for a fraction of a second, then returns to the fingers resting against the mask.

Armayil’s right hand and the cleaver remain low, outside this tight framing.

Cut with his left palm still resting in place.

SHOT 08B-03 | 09s to 15s | 6 seconds
THE RAISE AND THE REFUSAL TO LOOK

35mm close oblique handheld from SOUTHEAST, at the seated man’s shoulder height.

Older remains foreground left, head bowed. Armayil occupies center-right behind him, facing the seated man’s back.

His LEFT palm remains gently on the crown and back of Older’s mask.

The cleaver is visible low in his RIGHT hand beside his right thigh.

09–11s:
Armayil tries to lift his right arm. His elbow rises slightly, stops and sinks a few centimeters. His breathing breaks. His left fingers tighten against the rigid mask, then soften again.

The camera moves closer in a short, uneasy lateral drift, trying to keep the hand, bowed head and Armayil’s torso in the same frame.

11–13s:
Armayil forces his right arm upward, slowly bringing the cleaver beside and above his own right shoulder.

The blade remains clearly separated from the seated man.

The camera instinctively backs away and tilts slightly off-level. Focus slips from Armayil to the near edge of Older’s shoulder, briefly softening the raised arm.

Recover focus long enough to read the cleaver held aloft, Armayil’s trembling wrist and the effort passing through his shoulders.

13–15s:
Armayil holds the cleaver raised. His arm shakes. He has not begun the downward stroke.

The camera drifts left and downward as if the operator cannot continue looking directly at him. Older’s near shoulder partially obscures the frame; Armayil’s raised hand remains briefly visible at the upper-right edge before falling soft again.

Cut abruptly to black while the cleaver is STILL RAISED.

The downward stroke and physical contact occur outside this sequence.

END STATE AND EDIT

The Older Brother’s last visible position is seated, alive, head bowed.

Armayil’s left palm remains against the back and crown of the mask. His right hand holds the single cleaver raised above his own shoulder.

End before any downward striking movement.

This block is standalone coverage of the final hesitation inside the room. Its endpoint can be cut directly into the later aftermath.

CAMERA AND FOCUS BEHAVIOR

Handheld instability comes from the operator’s breathing, hesitant steps and involuntary recoil.

Use short physical drifts, imperfect reframing, momentary foreground obstruction and delayed focus corrections.

Each focus loss lasts only long enough to feel involuntary. Recover the essential visual information: the trembling left hand, its gentle contact, and the cleaver held above Armayil’s shoulder.

The image becomes hardest to hold at the moment Armayil raises the blade.

Maintain natural motion blur and real spatial continuity.

SOUND

Close, uneven breathing from both men.
Fingers pressing against worn clothing.
Armayil’s strained, broken exhale.
A faint contact as his palm settles against the mask.
Apron fabric tightening as his right arm rises.
Quiet practical-lamp hum and enclosed room resonance.

At the cut to black, cut immediately to silence.

The last audible sound is Armayil’s interrupted breath.

NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.
